bmr_scroll_poisonmist_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. From the sorcerer's outstretched hand, a swirling mist of toxic vapor emerges, shrouding the battlefield in a sinister haze. Beware its venomous touch, for within lies the essence of decay and demise.
bmr_scroll_portal_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Through whispered incantations and a flicker of arcane energy, a portal blooms, offering a shimmering gateway back to the familiar embrace of home.
bmr_scroll_repair_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. With a whisper and a wave, the Repair Spell mends the broken, restoring equipments to their former glory as if time itself obeyed the caster's command.
bmr_scroll_sailing_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. With a whisper to the skies, the sails filled with a supernatural gust. The ship surged forward, slicing through the waves with newfound speed and grace, guided by the wind's gentle, unseen hands.

Like an ethereal guardian, it stands firm, deflecting blows and safeguarding the wielder from harm's grasp.

Feel the power surge as your fingertips hum with the essence of age-old trees. With a flick of your wand, watch as branches part, trunks split, and timber yields to your command. Whether crafting, clearing, or conjuring arboreal wonders, the WoodCutting Spell ensures nature bends to your will.

bmr_seeker_cape_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Wrapped in the shimmering embrace of the Scarab Emerald Cape, warriors feel the ancient power of nature's guardians enfold them, offering protection as resilient as the earth and agility as swift as the wind.
bmr_seeker_chest_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Forged in the fires of ancient wisdom and adorned with the iridescent splendor of the scarab, the Crimson Chestplate whispers tales of resilience and protection. Its shimmering carapace, imbued with the hues of dusk and dawn, shields its wearer with the strength of a thousand guardians, their watchful eyes ever vigilant against the encroaching shadows.
bmr_seeker_hat_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Woven with threads of ancient tales and the vibrant essence of nature's guardians, the Scarab Emerald Hat whispers secrets of resilience and protection. Its shimmering emerald hues evoke the wisdom of the earth, while the scarab motif symbolizes renewal and transformation. Adorned with the grace of the desert winds and the strength of ancient civilizations, it stands as a testament to the wearer's valor and connection to the untamed realms.
bmr_seeker_legs_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the resilient shells of ancient scarabs, these Crimson Pants offer both protection and a touch of mysterious allure. Wearing them, one becomes a guardian of secrets, wrapped in the whispers of forgotten sands.
bmr_sorcerers_cape: Áo Choàng Tiên Phong Diệp Ảnh
bmr_sorcerers_cape_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Wrapped in the whisper of night, the Shadowleaf Vanguard Cape enfolds its wearer in veils of obsidian secrecy. Like a silent guardian, it melds with shadows, its threads woven from the essence of dusk, offering protection veiled in mystery.
bmr_sorcerers_hat_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the elusive shadows of the forest and woven with the resilience of ancient trees, the Shadowleaf Vanguard Hat whispers secrets of stealth and fortitude to those who dare don its enchanted helm.
bmr_sorcerers_trousers_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the elusive leaves of the shadowed forests, the Shadowleaf Vanguard Trousers whisper tales of ancient guardians. Light as a breeze yet tougher than tempered steel, they offer protection veiled in mystery, empowering the wearer to stride through darkness with unmatched grace and resilience.
bmr_sorcerers_tunic_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Embrace the whispers of twilight and the dance of shadows with the Shadowleaf Vanguard Tunic. Crafted from the elusive fibers of the ancient Shadowleaf, this armor veils its wearer in a shroud of mystery, blending seamlessly with the night. As silent as the breeze and as swift as the darting shadows, it beckons those who dare to walk the path between light and darkness.
bmr_spell_table_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Use to craft papers and magic scrolls.
bmr_spellbook_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. A mystical tome that stores spells and magic scrolls, preserving arcane knowledge for sorcerers and wizards.
bmr_tattared_chest_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the resilient fibers of ancient arboreal guardians, the Rootweave Chest armor melds nature's strength with unparalleled protection. Its intricate lattice design whispers of deep forest secrets, offering both shield and sanctuary to those who dare to tread the untamed paths of the wilds.
bmr_tattered_cape_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the resilient fibers of ancient trees, the Rootweave Cape embodies nature's fortitude, offering protection as enduring as the roots that anchor the earth. Its intricate design whispers of whispered secrets from the depths of the forest, weaving whispers of strength and resilience into the very fabric of its wearer's defense.
bmr_tattered_helm_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the ancient fibers of the Worldtree, the Rootweave Helm entwines its wearer with the essence of nature itself, offering protection as sturdy as the roots that anchor the earth and wisdom as deep as the forest's secrets.
bmr_tattered_legs_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the enchanted fibers of ancient trees, Rootweave Legs offer not just protection, but a symbiotic bond with nature itself. As you move, you can feel the whispers of the forest guiding your steps, weaving through shadows like roots seeking water, ensuring you remain steadfast in your journey.
bmr_voodoostaff_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Forged in the flames of ancient rituals, the Voodoo Staff pulses with eerie power, its twisted wood and sinuous carvings whispering secrets of the arcane. Wield it, and command the forces of the unseen, for those who dare stand against you will find themselves ensnared in a web of dark magic.
bmr_wand_ancient_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Carved from the roots of primordial magic, the Ancient Wand channels the whispers of bygone epochs. With each wave, it weaves spells echoing the forgotten wisdom of ages past, revealing mysteries lost to time.
bmr_wand_crystal_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Infused with the ethereal energy of ancient crystalline realms, the Crystal Wand channels raw magic into focused brilliance. With each gesture, it weaves spells of wonder, illuminating the path of wielders and unraveling mysteries hidden in the weave of reality.
bmr_wand_cursed_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Forged in shadows and whispered curses, the Cursed Wand holds within it a dark power beyond mortal comprehension. Each spell cast echoes with malevolent intent, leaving a lingering dread in its wake, for those who dare to wield it walk a perilous path between mastery and madness.
bmr_wand_elven_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Carved from the enchanted boughs of ancient forests, the Elven Wand channels the whispers of nature itself. With each flick of its slender form, it weaves spells of eldritch beauty, dancing between realms of light and shadow at the wielder's whim.
bmr_wand_ember_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Bathed in the glow of smoldering embers, the Ember Wand channels the fierce energy of flames into a dance of destruction. With each flick of its tip, it leaves a trail of searing heat, scorching foes and igniting fear in the hearts of those who dare stand against its wielder.
bmr_wand_root_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Carved from the ancient trees of the enchanted forest, the Root Wand hums with the whispers of nature's magic. With each flick, it channels the very essence of the earth, entwining foes in vines and unleashing the primal power of the wilderness.
bmr_wand_wooden_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Whispering secrets of the ancient forests, the Wooden Wand channels nature's magic with every graceful flick. Carved from the heartwood of an ancient tree, it hums with the echoes of woodland spirits, weaving spells as delicate as a leaf's dance on the breeze.
bmr_warlocks_cape_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Embrace the weave of magic itself with the Arcane Weaver's Mantle Cape, a shimmering veil that dances with the whispers of ancient spells. Woven from threads of mystic energy, it shields its wearer in a cocoon of arcane protection, where every fold tells a tale of enchantment and every stitch hums with the secrets of the cosmos.
bmr_warlocks_hood_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Wrapped in the whispers of ancient incantations, the Arcane Weaver's Mantle Hood beckons mastery over the unseen threads of magic. Wearing it, one becomes a conduit of arcane power, weaving spells with grace and precision.
bmr_warlocks_pants_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted by the mystical hands of the Arcane Weavers, these enchanted Mantle Pants weave layers of protective spells into their fabric, embracing the wearer in a shimmering barrier of arcane energy.
bmr_warlocks_vest_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted by the mystical hands of the Arcane Weavers, this ethereal mantle vest channels the very essence of magic. Woven from strands of raw arcane energy, it bestows both protection and power upon its wearer, intertwining the realms of defense and mysticism into one formidable garment.
bmr_woodstaff_description: Vật phẩm ma thuật huyền bí. Crafted from the heart of ancient forests, the Wood Staff whispers secrets of nature's power. With each strike, it channels the essence of the wilderness, blending strength and harmony into a formidable weapon.
